purpose: Prevent the qualification from attributing code-authoring capability to the A-01 execution host when the measured work was actually produced by a separate coding agent/model.
measured_subject_definition: The measured subject is the exact code-authoring agent configuration operating inside the A-01 controlled workspace and toolchain during the sealed 30-minute window.
validity_law: A run with an unidentified authoring agent is INVALID_RUN.
A run that exercises only A-01 qualification/execution commands is not evidence of code-authoring capability.
A run may be compared with another run only when subject-identity differences are explicitly reported.
Changing the authoring model, project instructions, tool permissions, or execution environment creates a new measured subject configuration even if the benchmark contract is unchanged.

current_repository_finding.finding: Checked-in A-01 infrastructure currently exposes qualification, scheduling, fenced execution, and repair-request paths; no authoritative code-authoring agent entrypoint has yet been identified for the CODE phase.
current_repository_finding.consequence: Do not execute or label the first 30-minute run as A-01 code-authoring evidence until the exact authoring entrypoint is bound.
